entries.en: to be right; to hit upon the right reason

entries.zh: 中节（合乎节度；恰逢其时）
entries.en: to hit the right occasion; to act in due measure and season

entries.zh: 中的（射中靶心；打中目标）
entries.en: to hit the mark; to hit the target

entries.zh: 经魁（乡试五经第一名；科举考试中式夺魁）
entries.en: to succeed in the examination, taking top place (ching-k'uei, head of a classic in the provincial examination)
a good start; good luck at the beginning; a good omen
entries.notes: 原稿汉字作'威實'，两栏音写与之一致，但其字面义与西栏'开头得利、吉兆'难以按字义直接互证，释义以西栏语义为准，待校对复核。

entries.zh: 打水（舀水；船上戽水排水）
entries.en: to bail out water (as in a ship); to draw or scoop water
to be bright, to shine; to clarify

entries.zh: 散（散开；消散，如云雾消散转晴）
entries.en: to scatter, disperse; of clouds or mist, to clear away
entries.notes: 原稿汉字辨识存疑[霰/散]，据两栏音写皆对应'散'字读音且与'散开'连用，判定为'散'。

entries.en: to disperse, clear away (of clouds or mist)
entries.notes: 原稿汉字辨识存疑[霰/散]，同上判定为'散开'。

entries.zh: 随时（顺应时势；随宜行事）
entries.en: to adapt oneself to the times; to suit the circumstances

entries.zh: 随夫贱（夫卑则妻随之卑；妇随夫之境遇）
entries.en: of a wife, to conform to her husband's lowly estate

entries.zh: 随夫贵（夫贵则妻随之贵；妇随夫之境遇）
entries.en: of a wife, to conform to her husband's honorable estate

entries.zh: 惜福（安于本分，珍视自身福分境遇）
entries.en: to be content with and cherish one's lot
to assist, aid (in office, work and the like)
to accompany; to attend upon one in office or dignity

entries.zh: 陪点（随侍在任；陪同当值）
entries.en: to attend upon one in office or dignity
entries.notes: 原稿'陪點'非现代通行词，'點'字在此的职能（或为当值义）依赖推断，释义据西栏'在职守或官爵上陪同'与'陪'字互证。
